label: Windows
requirements: Windows x64, PowerShell 5.1 or newer, and a device policy that permits this unsigned pilot script. Built and GUI-tested on Windows Server 2025; Windows 11 field validation remains pending.
launch: Open RedAgent from the Start menu.

label: macOS
requirements: Apple Silicon or Intel. The script chooses the native build, including under Rosetta. Built and GUI-tested on macOS 26 (Apple Silicon) and macOS 15 (Intel); older macOS compatibility is not yet established.
launch: Open RedAgent.app inside the installation folder in Finder.

label: Linux
requirements: x86_64 desktop Linux with glibc 2.35+, curl, tar, and X11 libraries. Built and GUI-tested on Ubuntu 22.04. No ARM Linux or musl/Alpine bundle is available.
launch: Run ~/.local/share/RedAgent/RedAgent/RedAgent in a graphical desktop session.
